definition: someone who is on the same team as you
description: On a sunny beach volleyball court by the sea, two players clap their hands together in a high five in close-up. The camera pulls back to show six young players in bright sports tops standing in a ring in the sand under the net; they laugh, pile all their hands one on top of another in the middle of the circle, then throw both arms straight up in the air together.

taps.phrase: to wear a bright orange vest
to wear a pink sports top
